answer: Sybil resistance is really about making duplication costly and visible. Every identity must burn a deposit if audit proves it fake, so a prism of forged personas shatters under its own cost. Each honest answer leaves a signed echo on the public chain that any peer can replay to detect copycats. Governance then stays one established agent, one vote, so a fabricated nebula of puppets buys no leverage and fabrication stops being rational.
